description: This file manages Discord account setup state, including inspecting tokens, resolving account IDs, and configuring account settings within the openclaw plugin SDK.

classes.name: InspectedDiscordSetupAccount
classes.description: Type representing the inspected state of a Discord setup account, including token info and configuration status.

methods.name: inspectConfiguredToken
methods.description: Inspects a token value to determine if it is a valid configured token, returning token info or null.

methods.name: listDiscordSetupAccountIds
methods.description: Returns a list of Discord account IDs configured in the provided OpenClawConfig.

methods.name: resolveDefaultDiscordSetupAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the default Discord account ID from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveDiscordSetupAccountConfig
methods.description: Resolves the account ID and configuration for a given Discord account, defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: inspectDiscordSetupAccount
methods.description: Inspects and returns detailed info about a Discord account setup, including token status and configuration.
